lessons.content:

📚 **Resources:**
• Linux File System: https://tldp.org/LDP/intro-linux

📝 **Exercise:** Change file permissions and create a new user account.

lessons.title: Linux System Administration
lessons.content:

📚 **Resources:**

📝 **Exercise:** Start and stop a service and schedule a simple cron job.

📚 **Resources:**

lessons.content:
Learn to install Windows from scratch. This covers creating a bootable USB drive, system requirements, partitioning, and completing the installation. You'll also learn about initial configuration and driver installation.

📚 **Resources:**
• Windows Installation Guide: https://support.microsoft.com/windows/install
• Rufus (Bootable USB): https://rufus.ie/

📝 **Exercise:** Create a Windows installation USB using Rufus.

📝 **Exercise:** Create a folder structure for your documents with proper organization.

📚 **Resources:**

📝 **Exercise:** Customize your display settings and configure a new user account.

lessons.title: Windows Security and Maintenance
lessons.content:

📚 **Resources:**

• Windows Update: https://support.microsoft.com/update

📝 **Exercise:** Run a full system scan and check for Windows updates.

lessons.title: Windows Networking and Internet
lessons.content:

📚 **Resources:**
• Windows Networking Guide

📝 **Exercise:** Connect to a Wi-Fi network and share a folder on your network.

lessons.title: Windows Troubleshooting and Recovery
lessons.content:

📚 **Resources:**
• Windows Recovery Options: https://support.microsoft.com/recovery

📝 **Exercise:** Create a system restore point and learn to boot into Safe Mode.
